messages.title: Stay positive
messages.body: It's great to be optimistic.
messages.evidence_locator: expectations discussion

messages.title: Discipline develops
messages.body: Discipline is what can I do to change someone's behavior to make them better.
messages.evidence_locator: player-discipline discussion

messages.title: Consistency wins
messages.body: Consistency in performance is probably the key to being successful.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement

messages.title: Coach has homework
messages.body: Well, I try to get better, I guess
messages.evidence_locator: answer to question about mediocrity; short excerpt

messages.title: Learn, then improve
messages.body: This is an opportunity for them to learn and grow and actually make improvements.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement about execution

messages.title: Miss Terry’s rankings
messages.body: I've always been behind the two dogs
messages.evidence_locator: opening family anecdote; short excerpt

messages.title: Check the ego
messages.body: check your ego at the door
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement; short excerpt

messages.title: Work in progress
messages.body: We're going to be a work in progress as we focus on improvement
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement; short excerpt

messages.title: Earn it again
messages.body: That's why it's very difficult to repeat.
messages.evidence_locator: rebuilding after a championship

messages.title: Finish the job
messages.body: Now it’s all about can you finish.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement

messages.title: Trust your team
messages.body: I trust our players.
messages.evidence_locator: response about the layoff before the game

messages.title: Breakfast of champions
messages.body: I had two today before the coffee pot was full.
messages.evidence_locator: answer about oatmeal cream pies

messages.title: Skip the hype
messages.body: rat poison
messages.evidence_locator: phrase Saban uses for distracting outside praise; excerpt, not a full sentence

messages.title: Keep building
messages.body: I want everybody here to know, this is not the end. This is the beginning.
messages.evidence_locator: Success Quotes section; secondary attribution

messages.title: Control today
messages.body: Put your effort into the next action you can improve, not the result you wish for.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Everyone has a role
messages.body: A team works when each person can be counted on to do their part.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Finish all four quarters
messages.body: Keep your effort steady through the final part of the job.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Trust is built
messages.body: Earn your teammates’ trust by being dependable when it matters.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: A realistic next step
messages.body: Know where you are, then work on the next step toward where you want to be.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Commit your time
messages.body: A goal needs time, dedication and persistence behind it.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Improve your response
messages.body: When something goes wrong, stay positive and work through the next challenge.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: More than a scoreboard
messages.body: Build habits and character that will matter beyond the game.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Know the assignment
messages.body: Understand the job, how to do it, and why doing it that way matters.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Show it consistently
messages.body: One good effort matters. Repeating it is how you build a standard.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Finish what you start
messages.body: Starting strong does not replace finishing well.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Confidence is prepared
messages.body: Learn the task well enough that you can perform it with confidence.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Learn the standard
messages.body: Clear expectations make it easier to take responsibility for your work.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Your habits travel
messages.body: Build habits now that will help you succeed outside football, too.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Help the next player
messages.body: Experienced teammates can set a positive example for the younger ones.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Reach your potential
messages.body: Judge your progress by how much of your own ability you are developing.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Energy is contagious
messages.body: Bring positive energy to the people working beside you.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Correct the mistake
messages.body: Notice what went wrong, learn the lesson, and make the next attempt better.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Ready before kickoff
messages.body: Your attitude and preparation shape how you begin the job.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Do your part properly
messages.body: Shared success starts with each person doing their own assignment the right way.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Explain the basics
messages.body: Do not assume a new teammate knows the expectations. Teach them.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Help new teammates
messages.body: Give less-experienced teammates the support they need to improve.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: A win still teaches
messages.body: A good outcome can still reveal things you need to fix.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Practice with purpose
messages.body: Use today’s opportunities to gain the experience you will need later.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Humility helps
messages.body: Keep your ego small enough to accept the role the team needs from you.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Serve the group
messages.body: Help the people around you succeed, instead of making every task about yourself.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Buy in, then work
messages.body: Complaining about the plan is not the same as committing to the work.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Support after setbacks
messages.body: When someone disappoints you, teaching and support still matter.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Choose useful habits
messages.body: Make daily choices that support the future you want.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Develop the person
messages.body: Help teammates grow as people, not just as performers.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Earn a new identity
messages.body: A team’s identity has to be rebuilt through everyone’s commitment.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Stay teachable
messages.body: Trust a proven approach while staying humble enough to learn.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Embrace the new role
messages.body: When your responsibilities change, learn them and get to work.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Prepare to rebuild
messages.body: Past success does not remove the work of developing the next team.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Confidence takes reps
messages.body: Consistent practice helps turn a new responsibility into a confident performance.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Improve together
messages.body: Keep developing the new people instead of expecting experience they do not yet have.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Remember what matters
messages.body: Value education and life beyond the playing field.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Appreciate the chance
messages.body: Notice the opportunities you have, especially after time without them.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Grow your consistency
messages.body: Build dependable performance a little at a time.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Culture carries forward
messages.body: Keep the commitment to developing people even as the faces on the team change.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Care comes first
messages.body: Show teammates that you care about them as people.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Respect the person
messages.body: Understand what someone is dealing with before you try to lead them.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Prepare, then perform
messages.body: Do the preparation that gives you a chance to play well.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Resilience earns chances
messages.body: Keep responding to setbacks; progress can create another opportunity.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Finish your opportunity
messages.body: Reaching a big moment is not the same as finishing it.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Edit your habits
messages.body: Match your daily behavior to what your goals actually require.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Build a lasting future
messages.body: Make choices that create value in your life beyond the next game.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Demanding and caring
messages.body: High expectations and good relationships can exist on the same team.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement and related answers; concise editorial summary of documented themes

messages.title: Family depth chart
messages.body: At 2014 Media Days, Saban joked that even the family dogs ranked ahead of him with Miss Terry.
messages.evidence_locator: opening family anecdote

messages.title: A growing bench
messages.body: Saban joked that a grandchild and his daughter’s engagement moved him farther down the family pecking order.
messages.evidence_locator: opening family anecdote

messages.title: Lizzie steals the show
messages.body: Saban recalled his boxer escaping a hotel room and finding him in the Media Days interview room.
messages.evidence_locator: opening anecdote about Lizzie

messages.title: Eight-iron accuracy
messages.body: The SEC’s 2021 introduction celebrated Saban’s hole-in-one on a 154-yard par three with an eight iron.
messages.evidence_locator: Commissioner Sankey’s introduction, not words spoken by Saban

messages.title: Degrees matter
messages.body: At 2021 Media Days, Saban highlighted that 25 players in the national-title game had already graduated.
messages.evidence_locator: opening statement about education

messages.title: Two before coffee
messages.body: Saban’s 2018 breakfast report: two oatmeal cream pies before the coffee finished brewing.
messages.evidence_locator: media-day breakfast interview

messages.title: The jelly debate
messages.body: When a player asked about grape or strawberry jelly, Saban said he did not mind either.
messages.evidence_locator: Da’Shawn Hand media-day questions

messages.title: The rat-poison remedy
messages.body: Saban later joked with Paul Finebaum about countering the distracting praise he called rat poison.
messages.evidence_locator: SEC video description, July 22, 2024
